explicit_nonclaims: TestPassReceipt is an integrity/assertion envelope with issuer_key_id fields; it is not a signed receipt and is not called signed.
ProofReceipt is a canonical integrity envelope projecting assurance from typed evidence; it is not a signed receipt and is not called signed.
Cache admission gates (formal_verification_cache, doctor_proof_cache, mcp_contract_proof_cache, prover_evidence_store) re-check keys and evidence; they are not receipt-aggregation proofs.
proof_attestation prepares statements only from existing independently kernel-checked ProofReceipt values; it does not claim arbitrary Python correctness from a ZKP.
provekit_setup and ipfs_datasets_zk_attestation close without tools/keys and never install packages; absence is typed unavailable, not fabricated capability.
proof_reuse_real_groth16_fixture discovers disposable test-only Groth16 artifacts; missing artifacts remain a typed non-blocking gap and never authorize a false skip.

program_analysis_zkp trace scope is narrow: committed public inputs open to a declared transition ending in the committed result; it does not prove inventory completeness or arbitrary runtime semantics.
repository_forest binds portable multi-checkout identity; it is not a proof-seal storage authority and does not decide reuse.
manual_completion_seal checks operator-issued external seals for protected activation; it is not cryptographic test-execution proof.
release_evidence exports and checks release-domain evidence bindings; it is not a production recursive verifier.
Controlled-offline baseline capture disables Groth16/ProveKit enablement, builds, downloads, and auto-install; the receipt reference does not establish new real proving.
Planning-time historical pytest counts and the unreproducible 257-result slice are not baseline evidence and are not reconstructed here.
No inspected accelerate surface implements a reliable recursive verifier; default aggregation remains Merkle manifest completeness.
Direct-execution, recursion, and production-key trust claims require executable evidence beyond static surface presence.

classifications.notes: proof_attestation.py defines receipt-bound ZKP statement/envelope/check contracts. Statements require an existing independently kernel-checked ProofReceipt; private witness material is non-serializable.
ProofReceipt is an unsigned integrity envelope; assurance is a projection of typed evidence, not a signature-check path.
TestPassReceipt records complete eligible three-phase fields including issuer_key_id; no signature checker is present. Not called signed.
Aggregates setup/call/teardown into TestPassReceipt; storage and deferred proving do not alter pytest outcome labels.

proof_reuse_real_groth16_fixture.py discovers real TestPass v4 binary/key artifacts and pure direct-node subprocess helpers. Missing artifacts are typed gaps; never injects production service identity.
kernel_verification.py independently rechecks reconstruction digests, forbidden declarations, and target kernel acceptance. Provider claimed status is untrusted.
prover_conformance.py binds property-specific semantic fixtures; cannot upgrade incomplete or non-conformant routes.
proof_fallbacks.py routes counterexamples and named validation IDs; fallback tests are not formal assurance and do not change proof verdict.
proof_metrics.py projects identifiers, verdicts, counts, and timings without proof bodies or witnesses.
prover_evidence_store.py persists conformance-bound portfolio keys; cache admission is re-evaluated and is not receipt aggregation.
manual_completion_seal.py checks content-addressed operator seals before protected activation. Scheduling metadata is not authority.
release_evidence.py exports and checks release-domain evidence; raw supervisor state is rejected as release evidence.
repository_forest binds commit/tree/gitlink/overlay identity for multi-checkout observation. Not a proof-seal store and does not decide reuse.
Companion manifest surface for repository forest portable claims.
proof_scheduler.py runs durable dependency-aware ProofPlan DAGs with leases/fencing, cooperative cancellation, and receipt deduplication. Presence is not recursive proving.
resource_scheduler.py admits host/provider capacity with integer-only serialization. Needs proof-seal stage and GPU-memory propagation for sealer use.
Multi-prover resource surface used with portfolio routing.
Routes prover portfolio selection; route presence is not proof acceptance.
provekit_setup.py content-addresses executable/setup/circuit/verifier identities and mandatory self-tests. Absent tools emit typed unavailable; never installs.
Binds available datasets Groth16/ProveKit backends to already kernel-checked receipt predicates only. Simulated or unavailable backends never satisfy production attestation gates.
program_analysis_zkp.py defines public commitments, private witness policy, and bounded program_contract_trace transitions. Simulated backends cannot emit authoritative ZK receipts.
Trust-aware receipt cache; every hit reconstructs ProofReceipt and re-derives assurance. Not a receipt-aggregation proof.
doctor_proof_cache.py federates lookups into FormalVerificationCache; negative or partial hits are diagnostics only.
MCP-specific semantic key adapter over FormalVerificationCache; not a second receipt store and not receipt aggregation.

Records capability health; probe presence is not production key trust.
